text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan hasn't been at her best, so I'm taking her to a shrine to boost our motivation. As we arrive…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Nakayama. Here to pray?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: As if. I'm just out for a stroll. Thought I might find someone to get into some action with.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And you? Not every day I find you at a shrine.
choice_data_list: She hasn't been in top form recently…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah? That's a coincidence. Actually, I've been on a bit of a losing streak myself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: At times like these, I just need one big win—doesn't matter what it is—and I'll be back on track. …So how 'bout it, Jordan? Care for a wager?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: If I can win, it'll turn my fortunes around! But one more loss… and it'll be a downward spiral to hell!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that sounds like a pain. I don't know jack about fortunes or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh… Afraid of losing? I get it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's not what I said.
choice_data_list: You don't have to force yourself to compete.
You don't have to force yourself to compete.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No, I can do it! Fine by me. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh! That's the spirit! All right, here's the bet… You just have to guess whether the next person to visit the shrine will be an Uma or not. Easy-peasy, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Okay, I'll bet on "Uma"!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Guess I've got "not Uma." Game on!
WAAAAGH! Where are yooou?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Someone's here!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's Tickezo! Woo! That means I win! ☆

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh! Heeey, Jordaaan! I was looking for you! I've got something I gotta tell you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Right! So, like, there's a present at the dorm for you! The box looks suuuper fancy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No cap?! It must be the prize I won in that online raffle! Yass! One good thing after another!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: For real?! That's great! Seeing you happy makes me happy!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Tch… Looks like that's a bust for me. Seems like you've got a stranglehold on all the good luck.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right. Are you gonna be okay? You said something about the "bottom of hell" or whatever?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I don't need your sympathy. I'm just extra pumped now, heheh. I need to figure out how to crawl back up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Festa leaves with a seemingly satisfied expression. Afterward, Tosen Jordan's slump seems to end miraculously!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, no one else shows up to the shrine, and it's almost curfew…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Laaame… Why isn't anyone coming? This is unreal.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Them's the breaks… We'll call it a draw. Let's have our tiebreaker another day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, with the match postponed, it looks like Tosen Jordan's fortunes aren't going to be improving today.
